SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. Bureau Station
No. S. B. D. 2588/31
Date 31 - 3 - 31/31.

Subject (in full) To paragraph 7 of Daily Intelligence Report of the 22nd inst.

Made by D.I. Hall. Forwarded by A. O'Dwyer. C. Insp.

Sir,

During the afternoon of 22-3-31 the undersigned, D.C.I.
Hall visited the area 170, particularly Louza Street.

I saw no signs of any disturbance but notices were
posted in the windows etc., relating to the Korean meetings.

The shops along the street appeared to be all closed
but on closer examination, it was found that the majority of
traders were keeping quite quiet, while a number of those
who were supposed to be closed, viz: on Nanking and Peking Roads,
had their doors open and were surreptitiously trading in their
shuttered shops.

500 A
Information
R. Hall

Book

Oc (S)
SI,
Information

Regs Please file J.P.S.

事由（详述） 关于本月22日《每日情报报告》第7段。

呈报人：侦探督察长霍尔（Hall）。转呈人：A. 奥德怀尔（O'Dwyer），总督察。

敬启者，

在1931年3月22日下午，具名者侦探督察长霍尔巡视了第170区，特别是劳合路（Louza Street）。

我未见到任何骚乱迹象，但窗户等处张贴了有关朝鲜人集会的告示。

沿街的店铺似乎全部关闭，但经仔细查看，发现大多数商人保持相当安静，而一些据称已关闭的店铺，即在南京路和北京路上的店铺，却开着门，在装有百叶窗的店内秘密进行交易。

Subject (in full) Labour Cessation.

Made by D. S. I. Widdowson, Forwarded by

Sir,

In connection with the Anti-Japanese Movement, 800 workers
employed by the Chung Hwa Book Co., Bubbling Well Road, failed to
report for duty at 7 a.m. the 23/7/31. No meetings or anything
of a disorderly character have been experienced so far. We are
informed that they will absent themselves until afternoon the
same day.

D. S. I. Widdowson.
D. S. I.

Subject (in full) Situation in Yangtszepoo District.

Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Wardrop

Sir,

At 9 pm 22-7-31, three Japanese Constables found
three posters of an Anti-Japanese nature posted on walls
in Ying Ziang hong village, Ward Road.
264 male workers of the San Sing Cotton & Iron
Manufacturing Co. No.1877 Ward Road, have been granted a
half holiday this forenoon.

I am, Sir,
R Wardrop,
D.S.I.

Special Branch.

At 9.40a.m. this inst. □□□□ of the Student Class
were brought to the Station in Motor No. 17545 permit 1097

this particular road to □□ for half day.

"The Whole Town to suspend their businesses for half day
in commemoration of the Chinese immigrants who are killed
